scopeExclusions: Ontology alignment is not database functionality and is not planned.
SPARQL 1.1 Update, Graph Store HTTP Protocol, Protocol and Service Description are separate W3C Recommendations and are not falsely claimed by this query-spec inventory.

features.name: SELECT query form
features.nextAction: Differentially qualify every SELECT algebra operator through the distributed and online paths against the zero-failure scalar oracle.

features.name: CONSTRUCT query form
features.nextAction: Qualify blank-node template scope, graph result equivalence and distributed serialization.

features.name: ASK query form
features.nextAction: Qualify distributed short-circuiting and online result negotiation.

features.name: DESCRIBE query form
features.nextAction: Specify one deterministic DESCRIBE algorithm, expose its contract and add W3C-plus-product tests.

features.name: Basic graph patterns and RDF term matching
features.nextAction: Complete W3C term-equality and active-dataset regressions on the online path.

features.name: Group graph patterns
features.nextAction: Lower all nested group operators into distributed stages with multiset equivalence tests.

features.name: OPTIONAL and left join
features.nextAction: Native-build and differentially qualify expression-free left join; expression-bearing OPTIONAL remains scalar-oracle partitioned until its worker protocol is qualified.

features.name: UNION
features.nextAction: Qualify the native bag-union kernel and complete-partition barrier against the scalar oracle on a multinode cluster.

features.name: MINUS
features.nextAction: Native-build and differentially qualify partitioned MINUS compatibility, especially disjoint and partially-unbound domains.

features.name: GRAPH and graph variables
features.nextAction: Run every graph-variable and correlated-subquery case against authorization-filtered multinode snapshots.

features.name: SERVICE and SERVICE SILENT
features.nextAction: Run official federated-query and failure-injection cases against multiple allowlisted endpoint pods while query-shard HPA and cluster autoscaling change capacity.

features.name: BIND
features.nextAction: Close distributed expression-error and variable-scope tests.

features.name: VALUES inline data
features.nextAction: Bound and distribute large VALUES tables while preserving active-GRAPH bindings and UNDEF semantics.

features.name: Subqueries
features.nextAction: Execute checksum-bound scalar-oracle subquery stages on workers and qualify projected-variable scope across complete partition barriers.

features.name: Property paths including arbitrary length
features.nextAction: Native-build and differentially qualify NFA frontier exchange, endpoint-set equality, hot-vertex splits, checkpoint resume and all-partition termination against the scalar property-path oracle before enabling the online distributed lane.

features.name: FILTER, expression errors and effective boolean value
features.nextAction: Build differential tests for every operator/function over numeric, temporal, language and error domains.

features.name: SPARQL operator and function library
features.nextAction: Differentially qualify scalar function behavior through distributed expression stages and online serialization.

features.name: Grouping and aggregates
features.nextAction: Qualify group-owner repartitioning and worker scalar-oracle aggregation for DISTINCT, expression errors, datatype promotion and empty groups.

features.name: ORDER BY, projection, DISTINCT/REDUCED, OFFSET and LIMIT
features.nextAction: Qualify scalar-comparator range sorting, k-way merge, exact DISTINCT ownership, REDUCED bounds and global slicing on multinode spill workloads.

features.name: FROM, FROM NAMED and active dataset
features.nextAction: Unify protocol/query dataset precedence across gateway, planner and all workers.

features.name: SELECT/ASK and graph result serialization
features.nextAction: Qualify JSON, XML, CSV, TSV and RDF graph content negotiation across online and distributed result assembly.

features.name: Entailment-regime query integration
features.nextAction: Native-build the online slice, execute every applicable OWL Direct regime case, qualify failure injection and indexed/closure differential equality, then activate the checksum-bound service-description gate.
